response.sql:
WITH filtered_films AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
),
per_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_rate_per_duration
  FROM filtered_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_duration) as overall_avg
  FROM per_rating_avg
)
SELECT 
  pr.rating,
  pr.avg_rate_per_duration,
  pr.avg_rate_per_duration - om.overall_avg as above_mean
FROM per_rating_avg pr
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE pr.avg_rate_per_duration > om.overall_avg
ORDER BY pr.rating

assumptions.assumption: "the average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration" means AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) for each rating—the average of individual quotients—rather than AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration). The phrase "average of X divided by Y" parses naturally as the average of (X/Y).

alternatives.interpretation: "the average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration" could mean the quotient of aggregates: AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) for each rating. This is less natural but grammatically possible.
